title: Colonel Wolodyjowski
writer: Jerzy Hoffman, Jerzy Lutowski, Henryk Sienkiewicz
actors: Tadeusz Lomnicki, Magdalena Zawadzka, Mieczyslaw Pawlikowski
plot: In 1668 Polish colonel Michael Wolodyjowski, who recently retired to a monastery, is recalled to active duty and takes charge of Poland's eastern frontier defenses against invading Tatar hordes and Ottoman armies.
